summary.text: Angelo Santabarbara is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 111 since 2013 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and People First Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is an engineer and the founder of the Santabarbara Cheese Company.

paragraphs.text: Santabarbara attended Schalmont High School, earned a B.S. from the State University of New York at Albany and served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1990 to 1998.
His professional experience includes working as an engineer and founding and owning the Santabarbara Cheese Company.
Santabarbara assumed office on January 1, 2013, succeeding William Magee.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Energy, Governmental Employees, Mental Health, People with Disabilities (which he chairs), and Racing and Wagering.
